name: sam_gov-mcp
description: SAM (deals): search_postings, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_sam_gov_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SAM_GOV_API_KEY
platform_mcp_sam_gov_api_key.description: SAM.gov public API key: sign in to SAM.gov → Account Details → generate the public API key (daily request limits depend on the account's role).

tools.name: search_postings
tools.description: Get Opportunities v2: notices posted in the last 364 days (postedFrom/postedTo are mandatory, MM/dd/yyyy, at most one year apart). query = title; category = NAICS code (ncode, up to 6 digits); offset is the page index ('Indicates the page index. Default offset starts with 0'). Award notices are included (type/baseType in raw); solicitationNumber, naicsCode, typeOfSetAside, pointOfContact, placeOfPerformance and the description link (raw.description, a URL needing the api_key) stay in raw. min_budget is not sent (no budget filter).

tools.name: get_posting
tools.description: The same search filtered by noticeid (only notices posted within the last 364 days can be found, since the posted-date window is mandatory).
